facts.text: Bryn Mawr and Haverford Colleges join together with Swarthmore College to form the Tri-College Consortium, allowing students to take classes across campuses and choose collaborative inter-institutional majors.

sources.title: Academic Partnerships - Bryn Mawr College
sources.quote: Bryn Mawr and Haverford Colleges join together with Swarthmore College to form the Tri-College Consortium. The Tri-Co offers students the opportunities to take classes not offered on their campus, and to choose majors which collaborate between the three schools.
